items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And what about the "Dipper Mouth"? [INTERVIEWEE] And the Dipper Mouth. That, too ... yes, yes.

ctx.x: The first solo that I copied, apropos of what you're saying now, was Frankie Trumbauer's 'Singing the Blues' -- ba da dee dee doo -- note for note, you know, so you're quite right there, and I remember how all the trumpet players used to play Louis Armstrong's 'Chinatown' and that was a big thing, you know - that was like in the early twenties, oh, '24, '25 -- or whenever.
And the Dipper Mouth. That, too ... yes, yes.
